title: Is Your Long AI Chat Burning Tokens? /clear vs /compact
description:
Is your long chat quietly burning tokens? 🔥

✅ /clear is a wiped whiteboard: a fresh start
✅ /compact keeps a short summary of old notes
✅ A summary of ten tokens instead of ninety saves eighty

Day 5 of Token Saver! Next up, Day 6: Short Prompts, Short Answers.
